details: PASS: markdown_document — report file is non-empty

PASS: section:Objectivity & Independent Validation — an 'Objectivity & Independent Validation' heading is present

PASS: section:Technical Component Analysis — a unified 'Technical Component Analysis' heading is present
PASS: section:Evidence & Falsification — an 'Evidence & Falsification' (or Falsification) heading is present
PASS: section:Recommendation — a 'Recommendation' heading is present
PASS: field:Assessment ID — '**Assessment ID:**' metadata is present
PASS: options_key:>=2 — options key lists 4 option(s) (need >= 2)
PASS: axes_present:capability+readiness — both 'capability' and 'readiness' axes are mentioned
PASS: no_redundant_component_tables — classification and gap analysis are combined into one 'Technical Component Analysis' matrix, not two separate overlapping tables
PASS: precision:no_unqualified_absolutes — Executive Summary avoids unqualified 'entire'/'all' capability claims, or names any minor external advantage as a 'harvestable delta'
